label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy _____, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verse: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
note: Jesus' prayer advice — shut the door; the Father sees what's done in secret.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no _____ with it.
verse: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
note: The LORD's blessing makes rich and adds no sorrow with it — no hidden fees.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became _____ unto it.
verse: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
note: Bitter Naomi ends the book with a baby in her lap — Obed, who would become King David's grandfather.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before _____, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verse: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
note: Moments after 'Judge not,' Jesus adds discernment: don't hand holy treasure to those who'll only trample it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is better to dwell in a corner of the _____, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verse: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
note: Better a corner of the 'housetop' than a wide house with a brawling woman — Proverbs liked it enough to say it twice (25:24).
